audit.evidence: **octop-harness** is a production-grade agent runtime built on the harness engineering theory. At its core it is a thin, battle-tested **encapsulation and engineering layer around deepagents** — we take the elegant `create_deep_agent` primitive from deepagents and package it with everything you need to run agents in production: multi-provider model routing, persistent memory, browser/search tools, a multi-agent registry, pluggable storage backends, and a terminal CLI. ／ |💾|**Pluggable backends**|Local disk, S3, COS, or PostgreSQL as the agent workspace| ／ octop-harness is a library (not an app) that turns deepagents into a deployable runtime.
